description:
Give the storage trait one conformance suite that each backend runs unchanged.

## Background

`IssueStore` (`crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs`, 21 methods) has two implementations: `JsonFileStorage` (`storage/json.rs:1042`) and `InMemoryStorage` (`storage/memory.rs:814`). No shared conformance suite exists. Three ad-hoc cross-backend reader tests live in `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`: load, list and resolve (`:220`), id resolution (`:278`) and the event log (`:691`), under a matrix header at `:644`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One conformance suite, written once against the `IssueStore` trait, covers its reader and writer methods and runs against both backends through one backend-construction seam.
- [hard] REQ-02: The three ad-hoc cross-backend tests are cases of the suite, and no copy remains beside it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Adding a backend to the suite takes one constructor; no case is written per backend.
- [hard] REQ-04: Both backends pass each case in the suite.

## Notes

Commit-pinned path reads join the suite once the in-memory backend serves them from its own state; today it reads the real disk for them (`storage/memory.rs:943-990`).
title: Shared IssueStore conformance suite runs against both backends
